title: suwa
description: FOV and Viewmodel adjustment for b1.7.3
body:
## suwa
FOV and Viewmodel adjustment mod!

### Features
- able to set fov between 1 and 180 in the mod menu config
- adjust your viewmodel


### Dependencies
- Ornithe Gen 2
- [Ornithe Standard Libraries](https://modrinth.com/mod/osl) >= 0.17.1
- [Mod Menu Ornithe](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu-ornithe) >= 0.4.0


![config menu for the mod with a FOV slider option with the value 100, a viewmodel options button and a back button in the corner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7333a64385259d20a097c556c76bed9cb52cc15e_0.webp)
